// A file this scanner cannot parse. Carried with a `.txt` tail so tsc's
// `test/**/*.ts` include never tries to compile it — the same trick the
// call-graph fixtures use for their degenerate shapes.
//
// IT USED TO BE A DECORATOR, AND ON 2026-09-08 THAT STOPPED WORKING — which is
// the whole point of this file arriving as a finding rather than as an edit.
// The refusal it demonstrated was a MISSING PLUGIN, so the day the scanner
// gained `decorators` this fixture began to parse and the four assertions
// resting on it would have gone quietly green about nothing.
//
// `with` IS REFUSED ON A GROUND NO PLUGIN CAN LIFT. A module is strict and
// `with` is a syntax error in strict code, so babel answers `'with' in strict
// mode. (1:0)` — measured under `typescript` alone, under the two decorator
// plugins, and under every non-conflicting plugin babel offers. A refusal that
// depends on a parser SETTING is a fixture with an expiry date; this one
// depends on the language.
with (o) { p(); }
export {};
